Lightkey's Benefits

Top questions about Lightkey

Is Lightkey safe to use?

Lightkey will never submit your content to the cloud. Lightkey is also Trusted by fortune 500 companies, and it follows the industry’s best practices for cybersecurity and privacy.

Why should I Upgrade to Pro?

Lightkey Pro offers unlimited predictions as well as advanced features that maximize your productivity. If you want to learn more about Lightkey Pro benefits, check out our premium plans page.

How do I install Lightkey?

Installing Lightkey is super easy!
Just download Lightkey, click on install, take our quick tutorial and you’re all set! Need help? check out our step-by-step installation guide.
